description: This file defines a React functional component named ChangeEditorButton, which provides UI functionality for changing the editor type for a note within a web application. It manages state and interactions such as opening a menu, handling keyboard shortcuts, and rendering related components like Popover and ChangeEditorMenu.

classes.name: ChangeEditorButton
classes.description: A React functional component that renders a button to toggle a menu for changing the note editor type in a note-taking web app.

methods.name: toggleMenu
methods.description: Asynchronously toggles the visibility of the change editor menu, invoking optional preprocessing before opening.

methods.name: disableClickOutside
methods.description: Disables clicking outside to close the menu, used to control user interactions.
